# References {.unnumbered}

This guide draws on a handful of textbooks, the original papers behind the
estimators discussed, and package documentation. The list below collects every
work the guide rests on.
The bibliography source is `references.bib` in the book repository. Keys shared
with the two causal econometrics guides and the blog book are kept unchanged, so a
passage can move between the books without a key being renamed.

Besides the works cited in the chapters, the guide draws throughout on the
textbooks of @baltagi-2013, @baum-2006 and @greene-1993. Greene is cited from
the 1993 edition; chapter, example and table numbers differ across editions.

The R packages loaded in the code examples are `cobalt`, `DRDID`, `fixest`,
`ggfortify`, `gmm`, `ivreg`, `knitr`, `MASS`, `OutcomeWeights`, `plm`,
`sandwich`, `strucchange`, `survival`, `synthdid`, and `WeightIt`, run under R
(R Core Team). Stata examples use Stata (StataCorp).
